title: Recovery and checkpoint source review
summary: Audit of recovery checkpoint files, selected text and structured evidence, code snapshot variants, and project JSONL records.
excerpt: 559 supplemental source files reviewed; 149 unique records published.
html:
Recovery and checkpoint source review

Read-only review of 559 selected source files from the ForgeMCP recovery checkpoint folders and Saved JSONL logs. Original evidence remains unchanged. The ForgeMCP_Recovery_Checkpoints tree contained 30,712 regular files across 39 extensions; 440 selected sources are individually dispositioned below. 377 code snapshots were hash-compared across 101 normalized paths, with 5 paths containing multiple variants.

Publication boundary

Unique recovery reports, test evidence, corroborating save and crash-context summaries, and selected JSONL outcome rows are published as linked derivatives. Identity/correlation traces, process handles, request/response transcripts, environment-specific settings, binary Unreal assets, generated caches, and files without a selected development event are accounted for but are not exposed as reading records. Credentials and workstation paths are redacted. The per-source manifest hashes selected sources; the full checkpoint inventory records extension counts without copying binary assets.
